page: Microsoft Azure E4-2ds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on Microsoft Hyper-V. The configuration features a single physical Intel Xeon 8272CL processor core yielding 2 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. Hardware capabilities include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache pool, alongside instruction extensions including AVX-512 and VNNI. The VM is paired with an expansive 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU allocation of 16.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is provided through a bundled 161 GB SSD, and the instance operates without a GPU or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark outcomes reflect the low physical core count paired with a dense memory footprint. In single-threaded processing, Geekbench returned an average score of 1242.0, while stress-ng recorded 1405.99. Due to having only 2 vCPUs, parallel processing capacity is constrained, evidenced by a multi-core Geekbench score of 1505.0 and a multi-core stress-ng result of 1847.88, both landing in the lower percentiles. Memory performance measured 12.62 GB/sec for uncached read-only streams and 12.69 GB/sec for writes, achieving an average PassMark memory score of 1909.53. In-memory data store performance registered 1.63 million operations per second in Redis SET tests.

The primary operational tradeoff of the E4-2ds_v4 lies in its constrained compute throughput against its high RAM density. Workloads requiring significant CPU parallelism will experience bottlenecks. However, for architectures that demand high memory capacity and fast temporary local disk caching without requiring extensive CPU cores, this profile offers an efficient resource allocation. The instance fits small-footprint in-memory caching systems, intermediate database staging nodes, and memory-intensive ETL tasks with low multi-threading demands.
description: Microsoft Azure E4-2ds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine delivering 32.0 GB of RAM across 2 dedicated vCPUs sourced from a single physical core of an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor at 2.6 GHz. The instance includes 161 GB of local SSD storage and lacks hardware GPU acceleration. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate moderate single-threaded responsiveness, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1242.0, balanced by modest multi-core throughput due to the dual-thread setup. Large-block memory transfers achieve roughly 12.6 GB/sec in uncached operations, while Redis SET throughput handles 1.63 million operations per second. The server offers a high RAM-to-CPU ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU, rendering it suitable for memory-dense, compute-light workloads such as small in-memory caches, light database instances, and memory-intensive batch processing tasks.
